added.title: Global Head of Product, T&S (Mandarin Required)
added.description:
Head of Product, Trust & Safety (Mandarin Required)

Location:

Singapore / NYC / Palo Alto

Industry

Consumer Internet / Technology

Function

Product Management
Trust & Safety

Language

Mandarin & English (Mandatory)

The Company

Our client is a leading global consumer technology company with a significant international presence and a rapidly expanding digital ecosystem. As the business continues to strengthen its international operations, it is investing in advanced Trust & Safety, risk management, and platform governance capabilities to support a safe, trusted, and scalable user experience. We are seeking an experienced Head of Product, Trust & Safety to lead the product strategy, development, and execution of critical safety and risk-management capabilities across international markets.

The Role

This is a senior product leadership position combining Product Strategy, Trust & Safety, Risk Technology, and People Management. You will lead a team of Product Managers responsible for building and scaling solutions across content safety, platform integrity, risk prevention, policy enforcement, and governance infrastructure. The role requires someone who can translate complex platform risks and operational challenges into scalable product solutions, while balancing user safety, operational efficiency, regulatory considerations, and business objectives. You will work closely with Engineering, Algorithms, Data Science, Policy, Legal, and Trust & Safety Operations teams across international markets.

Key Responsibilities

Define and execute the international Trust & Safety product vision, strategy, and roadmap.
Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Product Managers, establishing clear priorities and execution standards.
Drive product initiatives across content safety, platform integrity, abuse prevention, risk detection, and policy enforcement.
Develop and optimise moderation platforms, risk-control systems, policy enforcement workflows, and other Trust & Safety infrastructure.
Partner with Engineering and Algorithm teams to improve automated risk detection, content classification, decisioning, and enforcement capabilities.
Identify opportunities to leverage AI, machine learning, and large language models to improve Trust & Safety effectiveness and scalability.
Translate complex policy, operational, and regulatory requirements into practical product capabilities.
Establish product success metrics covering risk reduction, enforcement effectiveness, operational efficiency, and user experience.
Ensure product capabilities can support different international markets, languages, cultural contexts, and regulatory environments.
Lead complex cross-functional initiatives involving Product, Engineering, Data Science, Policy, Legal, and Operations.
Collaborate closely with senior stakeholders and technical teams based in China to align international product priorities with global platform capabilities.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a senior Product leader with strong experience developing and scaling complex technology products, ideally within Trust & Safety, platform governance, risk control, or related areas. The strongest candidates will have:

Significant Product Management experience, including leadership responsibility within a technology or consumer internet environment.
Proven experience directly managing a team of at least 5 Product Managers (mandatory requirement).
Demonstrated experience defining product strategy, owning complex roadmaps, and delivering products at scale.
Strong understanding of Trust & Safety, content moderation, risk detection, policy enforcement, or platform integrity systems.
Experience developing complex internal platforms, risk-control products, or operational technology systems.
Strong technical understanding and the ability to work effectively with Engineering, Algorithms, and Data Science teams.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with experience defining product metrics and driving data-informed decisions.
Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders.
Strong people leadership, organisational development, and stakeholder management capabilities.
Experience within a large-scale consumer internet, social media, UGC, marketplace, or technology platform would be highly advantageous.
Comfortable operating within a fast-paced, international environment.

Language Requirements

Professional fluency in Mandarin Chinese and English is mandatory.
Candidates must be comfortable conducting senior-level product strategy discussions, technical discussions, and stakeholder alignment in Mandarin.
Frequent collaboration with China-based Product, Engineering, and leadership stakeholders is a core requirement.
Conversational Mandarin alone will not be sufficient.

Particularly Relevant Backgrounds

Candidates with experience across the following areas will be particularly relevant:

Trust & Safety Product Management
Content Safety / Content Moderation Platforms
Platform Integrity / Abuse Prevention
Risk Control / Fraud Prevention Products
Policy Enforcement Systems
Platform Governance Infrastructure
AI / ML-Enabled Safety Systems
Large-Scale Internal Product Platforms
Experience within major global consumer internet, technology, social media, or marketplace organisations would be highly valuable.

The Opportunity

This is an opportunity to take ownership of a strategically important product function within a large-scale international consumer technology business. You will have:

Leadership of an established Product Management team
Significant ownership of international Trust & Safety product strategy
The opportunity to build and scale advanced AI-enabled safety and risk-control capabilities
Close collaboration with senior Product, Engineering, Policy, and Algorithm stakeholders
Exposure to complex product challenges across multiple international markets
The opportunity to shape how platform safety, integrity, and governance technologies evolve at scale
Meaningful influence over the company's international product and technology direction

For an experienced Product leader who combines strong people leadership, technical product depth, and Trust & Safety expertise, this represents an opportunity to build and scale critical platform capabilities within a growing international technology organisation.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

added.title: Principal Product Manager, Global Logistics Imports
added.description:
Description

Amazon Global Logistics (AGL) empowers hundreds of thousands of Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) sellers and other business customers with reliable, cross-border freight solutions — moving billions of products via ocean and air freight through the Amazon Fulfillment Network worldwide. We combine the scale of Amazon's global logistics network with real-time shipment visibility and seamless seller integration to deliver dependable, end-to-end supply chain solutions.

As Principal Product Manager for New & Emerging Geographies, you will launch new global cross-border origin-to-destination arcs and grow existing ones. You will own the product vision and roadmap with broad cross-organizational influence. This is a strategic, high-visibility, high-impact role at a pivotal moment for AGL — as we grow our product for businesses of all types amidst shifting global policies that are redefining how sellers move inventory at scale.

Key job responsibilities

Use customer insights and metrics to define product vision and the feature backlog
Work with finance, pricing, and operations to manage the P&L for each geographic arc
Drive growth performance accountability in business reviews using data analytics
Work with sales, marketing, business development, and operations on go-to-market strategy
Influence broad organizational direction through well-formed narratives and high-visibility leadership reviews
Navigate ambiguity across organizations to drive a unified global strategy

A day in the life

Your day will be a blend of data-driven decision-making, cross-functional collaboration, and leadership reviews. You will spend time gathering data and customer anecdotes to define a product strategy. You'll write documents to define your vision, while influencing across the broader product organization to ensure the most critical initiatives are prioritized. Expect to collaborate with marketing, sales, engineering, finance, and business intelligence partners to define product roadmaps, analyze data sets, and make impactful decisions that directly influence global logistics operations.

About The Team

The Global Logistics Imports team sits at the intersection of product, supply chain, and global operations. We are a fast-paced, globally distributed team that moves quickly, thinks big, and holds ourselves to a high bar. We value intellectual curiosity, strong ownership, and the ability to simplify complex problems into clear, actionable strategies. If you thrive in ambiguous environments and want your work to directly impact how hundreds of thousands of sellers grow their businesses on Amazon, this is the team for you.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree
10+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
10+ years of blending product and program management skills to execute strategic initiatives about process creation, standardization, and improvement experience
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with end to end product delivery
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience as a product manager or owner

Preferred Qualifications

MBA, or Advanced degree
Experience in transportation or supply chain
Experience launching products in international markets with different regulatory and operational requirements
Experience with cross-border trade compliance, customs, or international commerce
Familiarity with applied AI/ML in product development (demand forecasting, dynamic pricing, or automation)
Experience with data-driven decision making using SQL and business intelligence tools
Track record of mentoring and developing product managers
